courses.summary: 以已進入關閉復育階段的寒地鑽石礦為例，研究坑湖、水質與長期監測。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A sub-Arctic diamond mine in closure and reclamation provides a case for pit lakes, water quality and long-term monitoring. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
